excluded_campaigns.resolution: Entire campaign must restart from fresh coordinator state and new output directory after AC power is stable.
Entire campaign must restart after stable AC power is available; never splice samples across campaigns.
No AC-only campaign can be certified; no samples are spliced across campaigns.

limitations: Single-host Apple M4 sleep workload; not CPU throughput or multi-host recovery.
Detection includes durable requeue, logging and observer delay; assignment includes FIFO waiting.
Power and available thermal telemetry checked at run boundaries, not continuously.
Five measured repetitions per scenario; no confidence interval or exactly-once claim.
Raw evidence is Git-ignored and removed by make clean.
